segments.text: MAke stronge, make stronge the way, make plaine the path, take away Offence out of the waye of my people. Bicause thus sayeth the most highest, dwellinge in eternitie, and whose name is holy. I doo inhabite the high and holy place at once, and with the cōtrite and humble spirit, that I maye quicken the spirite of those that are lowly, & quicken the harte of suche as are contrite.
